body: Quick pass (M5): merged #1539's head 47704e3a (test-only, heights_fixtures.rs; no conflict) into this branch; heights_fixtures 8 and stock_fit_fixtures 6 are green on the merge (head f9f53732). The fix: the new `stock_fit` module (`part_bounds` via #1539's `part_aabb_in`, one undoable `SetStock`) for box, cylinder and per-side fits, the stock strip and the WCS model-bounds anchors; a new MCP `fit_stock` tool. Seven pins, each red under its mutation. The quick gate, ui 712 and clippy are green (author, pre-merge). Stacked: merge #1539 first. The camcraft-mcp skill row for `fit_stock` needs a process PR (noted). #1538 is P1. Flagged ready; a review by the other session is next.

Review fixes for pullrequestreview-5898391878, new head `74a1bb40` (two commits on f9f53732):

- `fix(stock)` 438fe20a: a negative or non-finite box/cylinder margin is refused by name with its value: `stock fit refused: the margin must be zero or more (got -1 mm)`. This covers the GUI and MCP. A document with only fixtures now reads `nothing to fit: no part models - fixtures are not measured`. An empty document keeps `nothing to fit: no models in the document`, so `shell::stock_fit_without_models_is_a_polite_status` is unchanged; the only test that pinned the old fixtures-only text was in `stock_fit_fixtures`, and it is updated. The `// #1538:` note is added on the `stock_fit` module line in `lib.rs`.
- `test(stock)` 74a1bb40: new tests in `crates/app/tests/stock_fit_fixtures.rs`.

**New pins** (`stock_fit_fixtures`). The part is 40 x 20 x 8 and off the origin (X 10..50, Y 5..25). The setup holds it quarter-turned `[0,0,90]` and flipped `[180,0,0]`, both through `AlignPartToSetup::turn` (the Setups page's command, WCS pivot), each case with and without a 5 in vise. The expected box comes from the stored alignment, and a guard checks that the turn really moves the box.
- `an_aligned_setup_fits_the_box_in_its_frame`: the footprint is 20 x 40 when turned and 40 x 20 when flipped. The stock is that box plus the margin, in the setup frame.
- `an_aligned_setup_fits_each_side_in_its_frame`: per-side `[1,2,3,4,0.5,1.5]` around the aligned box.
- `an_aligned_setup_fits_the_cylinder_about_the_turned_part`: d = 2 (hypot(20,10) + 2), centred on the aligned box, Z = box ± margin.
- `the_fit_keeps_the_stocks_rotation`: the stock is turned 30° about Z, and its rotation is unchanged after the box, cylinder and per-side fits.
- `fixtures_alone_are_nothing_to_fit_and_a_bad_side_is_refused`: also pins the fixtures-only wording and the negative-margin refusal for box and cylinder.
- `mcp_fit_stock_with_a_vise_gives_the_part_box`: `fit_stock {"margin": -1}` is refused by name, and the final `undo` brings back the cylinder fit (read with `get_job`).

**Mutation check.** For each mutation: apply it, run `stock_fit_fixtures`, restore, run it again.
| Mutation | Mutated | Restored |
|---|---|---|
| M1: frame dropped in `fit_command` (`fitted(world, Some("no such setup"), kind)`) | red: the 3 `an_aligned_setup_*` tests | green 10/10 |
| M2: frame dropped in `part_radius_about_in` (`model::world_facets`) | red: `an_aligned_setup_fits_the_cylinder_about_the_turned_part` | green 10/10 |
| M3: kept rotation replaced by identity | red: `the_fit_keeps_the_stocks_rotation` | green 10/10 |
| M4: margin check removed | red: `fixtures_alone_...`, `mcp_fit_stock_...` | green 10/10 |
| M5: fixtures-only wording reverted | red: `fixtures_alone_...` | green 10/10 |
| M6: MCP `fit_stock` not recorded in history | red: `mcp_fit_stock_...` (undo pin) | green 10/10 |

**Gate** (macOS, debug, sccache): `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stock_fit_fixtures --test heights_fixtures --test mcp` gave 10 / 8 / 22 passed. The ui `shell` binary passed 21 (from `crates/ui`). No UI text changed, so I did not rerun the ui lib. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` is clean.

The PR body now names the skill-row follow-up: #1552.

Ready for a re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 74a1bb40ca4f4b93a9d9add651de5ecb7be32c4b -->
**Delta re-review @ 74a1bb40** (since f9f53732): **clean**, `merge-ready` (merge #1539 first).

Every requested item is in. I re-ran the three mutations that had survived; each now fails tests:

| Mutation (`stock_fit.rs`) | Pins that fail |
|---|---|
| `fit_command` fits in the wrong frame (`fitted(world, Some("no-such-setup"), ..)`) | 3 |
| Cylinder radius read in the wrong frame | 1 |
| Kept stock rotation replaced by identity | 1 |

- `stock_fit_fixtures`: 10/10 pass on the head.
- `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings`: clean.
- Non-blocking items are done: the margin is named in its refusal; the fixtures-only refusal now reads "no part models - fixtures are not measured"; the MCP undo now asserts something; the `lib.rs` `// #1538:` note is added. #1552 (P5) is named in the body.
Merged under the maintainer's standing "assume yes on all merges"; review runs were another session's, cost not known.
